task: Run 5, second test-design batch for DAEO-0rfi (W2-54): fix the history readings of `test_w2_02_s_other_types_are_judged_as_an_unknown_type` so that each parametrisation reads the history it names, through W2-02's merge-back, under DEC-874 item 1, and prove the fix in the case's self-check.
status: DONE — commit `92ba6f02` is on `w2/W2-54`. The six S4 parametrisations pass on `HEAD` and on `4ce16df2`. No expectation changed.
work_completed: **Sandbox check first.** (a) The write outside the worktree failed with `OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`, so no file was made. (b) `git hash-object -w --stdin` worked (`1ae28402…`, exit 0) and `git update-index --refresh` worked (exit 0). The start checks matched: `independent-test-designer` / `DAEO-0rfi`, `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-54` on `w2/W2-54`, HEAD at `0ccafe25`. The `gov.__file__` line was `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-54/src/gov/__init__.py`. **The fault, step 2:** the old `_own_log` ran `git log … -- src/gov/check/schema.py <history>`. Git read the history as a path, so it walked the checked-out branch. **The fix:** `_own_log` now runs `git log --no-merges --no-renames --full-history <args> <history> -- <paths>`. The history always stands before `--`, so git reads it as a revision, and a revision that does not exist is git's `bad revision` error. `--full-history` makes the walk limited to the module also follow the side a merge did not keep. `own_added_lines` and `last_own_commit_of` now pass `paths=(rel,)`. The file case's reading goes through the same function with no path and gives the same answers as before. **The proof in the case:** I added `merge_back_repo` to the support module and the fixture `a_merge_that_keeps_its_own_side_of_the_module`, used through `_the_module_readings_read_the_named_history`. The built history: an own commit adds `audit-report` on `main`; a `Task: DAEO-zflj` branch writes `close` and `adoption-verdict`, then merges `main` with `-s ours`, keeping its own side; HEAD is left at the base. The self-check asserts five things: read at the merge, the last own commit is the own commit; its added lines are read; no line of the type is counted; read at `HEAD`, nothing is found; a history that does not exist, in the built repository and in this one, raises `bad revision`. I added a "Second batch" note to the README's "Run 5 (DEC-874)" section.
files_changed: tests/acceptance/W2-54/w2_54_support.py; tests/acceptance/W2-54/test_w2_54_audit_report.py; tests/acceptance/W2-54/README.md
evidence: **Commit `92ba6f02`.** Trailers: `Task: DAEO-0rfi`, `Role: independent-test-designer`, `Implements: DEC-773`, `Rewrite-Reason: DEC-874 (orchestrator, delegated, 2026-10-20): …`, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5`. `git log --oneline -2` shows `92ba6f02`, then `0ccafe25`; nothing unexpected. **Step 2, before the change:** `last_own_commit_of(schema.py)` gave `4f753c72…` for `HEAD`, for `4ce16df2` and for `w254-no-such-revision`. `own_added_lines` gave 11 lines in all three. `other_type_lines_brought_in(close / adoption-verdict)` gave `[]` in all three. Only `own_commits` (41 on HEAD, 38 on 4ce16df2) and the file reading raised an error on the revision that does not exist. Plain git on `4ce16df2`: `git log --no-merges 4ce16df2 -- src/gov/check/schema.py` begins at `f2776ce2` (DAEO-zflj) and never reaches `4f753c72`; with `--full-history` it begins at `4f753c72 DAEO-0rfi`. **Step 4, after the change:** `HEAD` gives `4f753c72`, 11 lines, `[]`, `[]`. `4ce16df2` gives `4f753c72`, 11 lines, `[]`, `[]`. `w254-no-such-revision` is an error in every reading (`git log … --full-history … w254-no-such-revision -- … failed`). **The self-check goes red without the fix:** a throwaway built the merge-back history and ran the self-check under each reading. The old reading fails it ("…misses the own commit that changed it"). A reading of the named revision without `--full-history` also fails it, and gives `None` on `4ce16df2`. The corrected reading passes it for both kinds. **Collection (step 5):** `14697/14699 tests collected (2 deselected) in 7.37s`, with no collection error. The W2-54 suite is still `97/99` (2 deselected), so no ids were added or lost.
tests: **The corrected cases, `-k other_types -v`:** 6 passed — `test_no_schema_file_…[HEAD]` and `[4ce16df2]`, and `test_w2_02_s_other_types_…[close-HEAD]`, `[close-4ce16df2]`, `[adoption-verdict-HEAD]`, `[adoption-verdict-4ce16df2]`. **`test_w2_54_audit_report.py` in full:** 23 passed, 1 failed. The failure is the known `test_core_schema_is_green_on_this_repository_with_w1_43_untouched`: `SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_TYPE` on `docs/close/DAEO-7rr2/CL-DAEO-7rr2.md`, "unknown record type 'close'" (W2-53's close record; only W2-02 defines that type). **The suite with `-m "not local_only and not shared_gpu"`, file by file:** cpu_embedder 14 passed; dropped_order 15 passed; query_cache 14 passed; query_vector 15 passed; sandboxed_worker 1 deselected; shared_gpu 2 deselected; time_limit 9 passed, 1 deselected (the lead's case). `test_w2_54_green_here.py` was not run (the lead's). The only case that is not green is the known core-schema case above.
discoveries: Two faults, not one. The history was read as a pathspec. Even with that fixed, git's default history simplification on a path-limited walk follows only the parent a merge kept, which would still have missed `4f753c72` on `4ce16df2`. Both faults are fixed, and each one makes the new self-check fail. During the cpu_embedder/query_* runs the sandbox refused outbound connections to `ollama.com:443`; those tests still passed.
risks: The `-s ours` merge in the built history is the extreme case, a merge that keeps its own side of the whole tree. W2-02's real merge-back kept its side of the module only. `--full-history` handles both shapes, but only the extreme one is built. The risk the README already names for the behavioural half is unchanged.
lessons: In `git log`, a revision placed after `--` is silently read as a path. Always end the command with `<rev> -- <paths>`. A path-limited walk across merges needs `--full-history` to find commits on the side a merge did not keep.
